title: Implement an LRU cache with TTL
goal: Implement shop.cache.TTLCache exactly as specified in its docstring.
acceptance_criteria: TTLCache(max_size, ttl, clock=time.monotonic) raises ValueError for max_size < 1 or ttl <= 0
set stores a value that expires when clock() >= set time + ttl; get returns the default for missing or expired keys and removes expired ones
a successful get and every set make the key most recently used; get does not extend the ttl
when size would exceed max_size, expired entries are purged first, then least recently used entries are evicted
len() and `in` ignore expired entries (`in` does not change recency); purge() removes expired entries and returns how many
constraints: the clock is injectable and must be the only time source
